from collections import Counter, deque

def _components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            color=grid[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); pts=set()
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); pts.add((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            out.append((color,pts))
    return out

def _l(pts):
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    if len(pts)<5: return None
    for r in (r0,r1):
        for c in (c0,c1):
            if pts==({(r,x) for x in range(c0,c1+1)}|{(y,c) for y in range(r0,r1+1)}):
                return r,c,(1 if r==r0 else -1),(1 if c==c0 else -1)
    return None

def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps=_components(grid,bg)
    ms=[(len(p),color,p,_l(p)) for color,p in comps if _l(p)]
    if not ms: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,mc,mp,(r,c,vd,hd)=max(ms,key=lambda x:x[0])
    cand=[]
    for color,p in comps:
        if color==mc or _l(p): continue
        cy=sum(y for y,x in p)/len(p)
        if (cy-r)*(-vd)<=0: continue
        r0=min(y for y,x in p); r1=max(y for y,x in p)
        c0=min(x for y,x in p); c1=max(x for y,x in p)
        dy=max(r0-r,0,r-r1); dx=max(c0-c,0,c-c1)
        cand.append((dy+dx,-len(p),p))
    if not cand: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target=min(cand,key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1]))[2]

 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque


def _components(grid, bg):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen, out = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color, q, pts = grid[r][c], deque([(r, c)]), set()
            seen.add((r, c))
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                pts.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                            (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color):
                        seen.add((yy, xx)); q.append((yy, xx))
            out.append((color, pts))
    return out


def _l(pts):
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    for r in (r0, r1):
        for c in (c0, c1):
            if pts == ({(r, x) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)} |
                       {(y, c) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)}):
                return r, c, (1 if r == r0 else -1), (1 if c == c0 else -1)
    return None


def transform(grid):
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps = _components(grid, bg)
    markers = [(len(p), color, p, _l(p)) for color, p in comps if _l(p)]
    if not markers:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _, marker_color, marker, (r, c, vd, hd) = max(markers, key=lambda x: x[0])
    # The target lies in the open quadrant opposite the two arms of the L.
    # Prefer objects wholly in that quadrant; use center position if none qualify.
    strict, loose = [], []
    for color, pts in comps:
        if color == marker_color or pts == marker:
            continue
        r0, r1 = min(y for y, x in pts), max(y for y, x in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(x for y, x in pts), max(x for y, x in pts)
        cy = sum(y for y, x in pts) / len(pts)
        cx = sum(x for y, x in pts) / len(pts)
        ydir, xdir = -vd, -hd
        in_strict = ((r0 > r if ydir > 0 else r1 < r) and
                     (c0 > c if xdir > 0 else c1 < c))
        in_loose = ((cy-r)*ydir > 0 and (cx-c)*xdir > 0)
        dist = min(abs(y-r) + abs(x-c) for y, x in pts)
        if in_strict:
            strict.append((dist, -len(pts), pts))
        elif in_loose:
            loose.append((dist, -len(pts), pts))
    choices = strict or loose
    if not choices:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    target = min(choices, key=lambda z: (z[0], z[1]))[2]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for y, x in target:
        out[y][x] = marker_color
    return out
